title: Escalation
description: Fires when any specialist hits its Rule 0. Routes the situation to a human for resolution. Never guess, never invent — escalate. The system's integrity depends on this schema being used correctly.

escalation_type.description: The category of escalation. Human reads this first to understand what they're walking into.

reason.description: Plain-English explanation. What exactly went wrong. Which field is missing. What conflicted. Written for Diana, not for a developer.

to.description: diana = team owner decision required. assigned_agent = agent can resolve. orchestrator_retry = send back to orchestrator with more context.

original_input_ref.description: handoff_id of the input that caused the escalation. Enables full trace.

partial_output.description: What the specialist had completed before escalating. Preserves work so the human doesn't start from scratch.

suggested_resolution.description: Optional: what the specialist would suggest the human do. Not a decision — just context.

urgency.description: blocking = deal at risk or deadline missed. high = same-day resolution needed. normal = resolve before next interaction.
